text:
zoe: Morning crew idea 373954: Early-Bird Bagel Brigade next Friday at 8am in the kitchen nook. Quick, 30-min meetup for bagels + short standup chit-chat. Who wants in?

michael: Love it 60a. I'll be there. Could we do an everything bagel option?

tiffany: Count me in. Can we have one vegan spread option please (no dairy)?

ben: In. Also can we make it a "bring-a-topping" thing instead of one person doing all the spreads? Less work for one volunteer.

zoe: Good call. Let's do shared toppings. Quick poll for bagel counts: reply with number of bagels you'll bring (0 if none). I'll order extras if needed.

michael: 3

tiffany: 0 (will bring toppings)

ben: 4

laura: 2 (gluten-free bagels pls for me)

zoe: Awesome. Toppings sign-up: cream cheese (plain), chive, smoked salmon, hummus (vegan), avocado smash, butter, jam, sliced tomato/cucumber. Reply with the toppings you'll bring.

michael: cream cheese plain + chive

tiffany: hummus + avocado smash (vegan)

ben: smoked salmon + sliced tomato

laura: jam + butter (gf bagels for me)

opsbot: Reminder: Please declare any allergies in-thread for catering records. Security: if event time is before 9am, door access may be restricted.

zoe: Noted. Allergies: michael - shellfish (mild), laura - gluten. No nuts among us.

michael: typo: shellfish allergy noted (I'll avoid smoked oysters etc).

ben: Logistics Q: Do we have a toaster big enough? Office toaster is pretty tiny.

tiffany: I can bring an extra pop-up toaster and a tray. Also a small travel kettle for tea.

zoe: Thanks! Also who can grab the conference table nearest the window for standing space? Need one long surface.

laura: I'll drag it over at 7:45.

michael: Can we keep music low? Early folks will be on their way to meetings. Maybe ambient playlist.

ben: I'll queue a soft morning playlist.

zoe: Ops note: @opsbot can you confirm kitchen access at 7:30 so we can set up?

opsbot: Ops ticket submitted: #5123. Access granted for 7:15-9:00. Please ensure cleanup.

zoe: Perfect. Quick extra: shall we make it a recurring weekly "Bagel Brigade" or just one-off? Reply with Y for weekly or N for one-off.

michael: Y

tiffany: N (just this week for me)

ben: Y from me. Good way to catch up.

laura: Y if it's every-other-week.

zoe: Ok majority leaning Y 1 over N but I'll propose every-other-week if turnout drops. We'll trial weekly for a month.

michael: Also bringing a tiny tub of strawberry jam that is nut-free.

tiffany: I'll bring a small label pack so people can mark vegan/gluten-free items.

ben: I'll handle cleanup roster 44d. Please chip in 5 minutes after 8:30.

zoe: RSVP list so far: zoe, michael, tiffany, ben, laura. If anyone else wants to swing by, drop a quick "+1" here.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: "Early-Bird Bagel Brigade" at 08:00 Friday 373. Reminders 24h and 30m prior.

michael: Thanks for organizing zoe! See you all.

zoe: Happy to! See you Friday 60a
